name: Inmate Crafty
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve green cap, orange torn sleeveless uniform, muscular adult figure and huge taped cardboard fantasy blade. Source footwear is cropped; complete the wide pose with plain dark work boots. Review one coherent weapon, body/hand anatomy, bounded slash effects and padlock-only contact.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Inmate Crafty — Make Do.
IDENTITY: exact muscular adult brown-skinned man with a dark green flat-topped cap, short dark hair, tense determined face, ragged sleeveless orange uniform over a dark undershirt and matching orange trousers. His already-complete enormous fantasy paddle-shaped blade is made of brown cardboard reinforced with broad silver tape and small silver edge pieces, with a dark wrapped handle. Preserve this distinctive illustrated prop exactly as a stylized fictional game weapon. Do not show its manufacture or explain construction. Complete cropped footwear with plain dark work boots.
0–0.7s: establish full figure and entire huge weapon over his shoulder. A colossal detached dark iron padlock, larger than his body, drops into view ahead of him. He tightens his two-handed grip and lowers into a powerful springing crouch.
0.7–2.5s: he launches into one high forward somersault, carrying the entire oversized blade through a blazing overhead arc. Camera pulls back and tilts up to reveal the enormous padlock and his airborne silhouette. At the peak he drives ONE downward cleave through the padlock, splitting the object cleanly into two huge halves. Pause briefly at contact with a massive bounded warm-white/orange jagged star, then the halves spin apart at violent speed. A thick finite cream slash crescent follows the weapon and ends on cyan, no diagonal background panel or full-screen flash. No people are struck, no injury.
2.5–3.5s: camera races through the opening between the departing lock halves and snaps back onto his proud face as he returns to a wide balanced stance. Exact title MAKE DO slams beside his shoulder and settles below his face.
3.5–5s: readable full-body hero hold with the huge blade propped over one shoulder, complete silhouette in frame. One loose tail of silver tape unrolls comically from the weapon; he catches it and gives it one irritated pat back into place. Keep cardboard texture, cap, hands and face consistent. SFX: heavy weapon creak, rising acrobatic whoosh, one overwhelming iron split CRACK with bass impact, spinning metal tails, title slam and final sticky tape rip. No music or speech.
